name: 3_build_steps_breakdown
summary: Show the intermediate build steps/plan (what to craft at each tier), not just the flat material total.
description: Builds on material_summary by presenting, for a given top-level recipe x quantity, how many runs of EACH recipe in the exploded tree are needed and how much output that yields - e.g. 'run the Sulfuric Acid reaction 5 times, resulting in 1000 Sulfuric Acid', for every intermediate recipe up through the final product. Explicitly NOT about the per-step material inputs (that's already covered by material_summary's flat totals) - this is a runs-per-recipe list/tree. Backend returns this as JSON; frontend presentation (list, tree, wording) is secondary and flexible. Done when a multi-tier recipe produces a readable ordered list of {recipe, runs, output_quantity} rather than just a flat material totals list.
